title: PagerArchive agency profile
description: One agency's page formats (SPEC.md section 6.4, ADR 0001 section 2). Formats are tried in order on the redacted text with the priority marker removed.

labels.description: Display labels per field: field name to (code to label). Display only (P3).

large_event_fields.description: Field values that open a large event (R87): an Emergency page to an aliased capcode whose field holds one of the listed values opens or joins one, as a page with a code does. Values are compared exactly, as extracted (P3).

levels.description: Ordered level fields (R7, R49a), such as an alarm level: each a text field the formats extract, with its values in order, lowest first, each with a label. An integration's filter can keep pages at or above one of the levels; a value not listed is never at or above any. Shown only in the integration form; display and filter only, so changing them re-parses nothing.

field.description: A text field one of the formats extracts: a named group, or an address_split output.

label.description: What the field is called in the integration form, such as "Alarm level".

values.description: The field's levels, lowest first: each value as extracted (P3) and its label, such as "Second alarm".

field.description: A text field one of the formats extracts: a named group, or an address_split output.

values.description: The values that open a large event, each listed: any other value, or none, doesn't.

priorities.description: Priorities this format applies to. Omitted: every priority, including none.

match.description: RE2 regular expression. Named groups become fields; groups starting with _ are intermediate. Empty matches everything (text-only format).

fields.description: Post-processing for captured groups, keyed by group name.

split.description: RE2 pattern that splits the value into a list. Elements are trimmed; empty ones are dropped. An empty pattern splits into single characters.

into.description: Moves some of the split list's tokens into another list (R7, ADR 0047): each token that is one of the known values (values, values_file) or that match matches in full moves to field, in its order; the others stay. Values are compared exactly as extracted (P3). Needs split beside it.

field.description: The list the tokens move to: call_signs (shown as Call signs), units, or an extra field. Not the field being split, a single-value standard field, or a field the format captures.

values.description: Known values: a token equal to one moves.

values_file.description: Known values in a file beside the profile (relative to it): UTF-8 text, one value a line; lines are trimmed, and blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped. Name it .txt. Its values count in what decides a re-parse (R23a).

match.description: RE2 pattern a whole token must match to move (anchored as ^(?:...)$), for values that follow a shape.

address_split.description: Splits the value at the longest suffix that is [house number] <street> <locality> from the address dataset.
